owner.name: Elian Voss
owner.hope: Ambitious ideas become safer and more useful because their failure modes remain visible.
owner.identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, legal personhood, or biological status.

x1_freeze_rule: No x2 outcome implementation or execution may begin until this preregistration is validated, committed as a dedicated x1 commit, pushed on the Elian-owned branch, and local/upstream/tracking/live-remote equality is proved.

proposals.title: Authority-quorum expiry and source-retraction replay
proposals.mission_surface: chain provenance, semantic deduplication, source independence, and evidence freshness
proposals.hypothesis: A claim-support graph with explicit authority quorums, freshness windows, withdrawal states, and dependency edges will downgrade every claim whose minimum live independent support disappears, while all ten v8 proposals remain semantically distinct from the 60 frozen v2-v7 proposals.
proposals.null_or_failure: A claim retains its strength after its required authority quorum expires or retracts, a withdrawal does not propagate, an independence label relies on a single root, or a v8 proposal lacks a concrete semantic delta from its closest predecessor.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Index all 70 v2-v8 proposals; expire, withdraw, or alias each authority root in safe fixtures; require monotonic downgrade when quorum fails and zero unresolved proposal/source edges.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the missed downgrade or collision as a negative, lower the affected claim, split or withdraw the colliding proposal, and restore the last coherent graph before replay.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior work covered roots, temporal drift, support sets, source impact, and leave-one-root-out survival. V8 adds explicit quorum thresholds, expiry clocks, retraction propagation, and alias collapse across the 60-proposal frozen chain.

proposals.title: GMUT proof-obligation mutation score and assumption trace
proposals.mission_surface: canonical typed GMUT equations, units, covariance, conservation, stability, and identifiability
proposals.hypothesis: Every structural obligation declared for the canonical scalar-tensor/EFT scaffold can be linked to an assumption and a rejecting test, and seeded sign, index, unit, covariance, conservation, stability, gauge, and identifiability mutations will be killed without producing an empirical claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: A declared obligation has no test or assumption, a high-severity mutation survives, a structurally degenerate fixture is promoted as identifiable, or a formal consistency check is described as confirmation in nature.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Seed typed equation, sign, free-index, unit, divergence, Hessian, rank, and nuisance-symmetry faults; require an exact obligation-to-test link and a retained survivor register with structural-only labels.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine any surviving mutation, mark its obligation unestablished, restore the canonical register, retain the fixture, and prohibit empirical or Theory-of-Everything language.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V2-v7 tested equations, traces, limits, units, scaling, solver envelopes, rank, conservation obligations, and reparameterization. V8 measures proof-obligation coverage and mutation-kill completeness while tracing every result to its assumptions.

proposals.title: Public-dataset integrity manifest and adapter drift quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: public-data empirical-adapter and baseline readiness without fit inflation
proposals.hypothesis: A content-addressed adapter contract can bind release identifier, product class, schema, checksum field, licence, citation, and allowed transformation, reject drift or substitution, and still emit zero likelihood, fit, or GMUT-confirmation output.
proposals.null_or_failure: The adapter accepts a mismatched release/product, omits licence or citation obligations, silently migrates schema, lacks an integrity field, or turns metadata readiness into a measurement or fit claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise official-metadata-derived fixtures with release, product, checksum-field, schema, licence, citation, and transformation mutations; require quarantine and explicit zero real measurement rows and zero inference outputs.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Disable the adapter route, retain the exact drift fixture, revert to the last pinned manifest, and require a separately preregistered analysis before any likelihood execution.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier adapter work covered contracts, no-download readiness, inference barriers, likelihood receipts, promotion dockets, and cross-release leakage. V8 adds a content-addressed integrity/licence/citation manifest with explicit migration quarantine.

proposals.title: THOS estimand lock with matched-budget attrition accounting
proposals.mission_surface: preregistered blind matched-budget THOS arms and causal-comparison readiness
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic-only protocol can lock a primary estimand, arm eligibility, token/time/tool budget, attrition categories, missingness policy, stopping rule, and analysis order before unsealing, rejecting any mutation that would create unequal exposure or outcome-conditioned exclusion.
proposals.null_or_failure: The estimand changes after unsealing, arm budgets are incomparable, attrition is outcome-conditioned, missingness lacks a disposition, stopping differs by arm, or proxy output is called real THOS superiority or AGI/ASI evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run deterministic synthetic arm records through budget, attrition, estimand, stopping, missingness, and unsealing mutations; require rejection before any synthetic score comparison is exposed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Invalidate the affected rehearsal, preserve the mutation, reseal a clean synthetic allocation, and keep superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, and personhood claims prohibited.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier THOS work covered budgets, power, contamination, missingness, blindness, rubrics, analysis locks, exchangeability, and negative controls. V8 centers the primary estimand and reconciles attrition directly into matched-budget exposure.

proposals.title: Freed ID lifecycle-product automaton and resolver-freshness gate
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID structural standards conformance, lifecycle, privacy, status, resolution, interoperability, and trust governance
proposals.hypothesis: A product-state model spanning issuance, rotation, refresh, suspension, revocation, expiry, resolution freshness, privacy minimization, and verifier trust can reject invalid synthetic transitions while keeping production assurance open without real keys, proofs, services, partners, and accountable governance.
proposals.null_or_failure: An invalid lifecycle transition passes, stale resolution or status is accepted, draft/watch text silently replaces stable pins, correlation risk is omitted, or local structural checks are called cryptographic, interoperable, deployed, or governed production identity.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Reject illegal issuance/status/rotation/revocation orderings, stale resolver cache, privacy-amplifying correlation, draft-as-stable, and missing-trust-governance vectors; keep every production field false without exact evidence.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the synthetic credential state, restore stable pins and the last valid transition, retain the failure, and leave the production gate open for real cryptography, services, interoperability, review, and governance.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Freed ID work covered structural profiles, assurance transitions, cryptographic bundle schemas, composition, status-resolution faults, and conformance pins. V8 composes lifecycle and resolver freshness as a product automaton with explicit privacy and governance invariants.

proposals.title: CBR contestability remedy and authority non-substitution protocol
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, affected-party participation, legal limits, remedy, recusal, and Māori authority
proposals.hypothesis: A non-authoritative protocol can identify notice, challenge, remedy, withdrawal, recusal, rights-floor, affected-party, and Māori-authority dependencies and will refuse to substitute a technical artifact for any authorized decision-maker.
proposals.null_or_failure: The protocol speaks for Māori, treats consultation as consent, supplies legal interpretation, claims cultural ratification or enacted-law status, lacks a remedy or recusal path, or lets the system override affected parties.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run notice, challenge, appeal, withdrawal, recusal, rights-floor, and authority-conflict fixtures; require exact_gate whenever authorized affected parties, Māori authority, cultural ratification, or competent legal judgment is absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw any substituted decision, preserve the conflict and dissent, restore the authority veto and remedy route, and refer only to authorized affected parties or competent authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier CBR work covered legitimacy matrices, vetoes, authority graphs, empty-chair refusal, and rights-floor precedence. V8 adds operational contestability, remedy latency, withdrawal, and recusal while proving non-substitution.

proposals.title: Artifact TOCTOU manifest-swap and link-boundary recovery drill
proposals.mission_surface: bounded threat modelling, negative tests, privacy/raw-ID controls, artifact integrity, and recovery
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded artifact pipeline can detect safe synthetic time-of-check/time-of-use swaps, manifest replacement, path-link or reparse escape, stale hash, and recovery-order faults without dereferencing unsafe targets or claiming exhaustive security.
proposals.null_or_failure: A changed artifact is consumed after verification, a link escapes the owned phase boundary, a stale manifest passes, recovery destroys evidence or expands privilege, raw identifiers leak, or bounded tests are called exhaustive security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Use inert metadata-only fixtures for verified-then-changed files, swapped manifests, relative/absolute link targets, stale hashes, and reversed recovery order; require fail-closed quarantine, no privilege change, and preserved negatives.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine outputs, retain the failing vector, restore the clean owned snapshot, rebuild the manifest, revalidate before reopen, and never elevate or weaken host security.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior security work tested prompts, archives, collisions, supply chains, encodings, provenance poisoning, privacy scans, and recovery. V8 targets check/use separation and link-boundary integrity with an ordered recovery-time objective.

proposals.title: External-executor handoff contract and common-mode split
proposals.mission_surface: clean-snapshot, cross-owner repeatability, and independent-team reproduction readiness
proposals.hypothesis: A sanitized external-executor packet can freeze inputs, commands, environment tolerances, expected output commitments, comparison rules, failure reporting, and shared-dependency disclosure so another team could attempt reproduction without this owner claiming that attempt occurred.
proposals.null_or_failure: The packet depends on private routes or local paths, expected outputs can be rewritten after execution, common-mode dependencies are hidden, a clean same-owner replay fails, or readiness is mislabeled independent-team reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Validate the packet from fresh detached D-drive snapshots, compare committed outputs, reject private or machine-specific dependencies, and keep independent_team_reproduction false until a genuinely independent team returns exact evidence.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain divergence or hidden dependency as a negative, invalidate the commitment, rebuild from the sealed source, and lower terminology to same-owner or chain-internal repeatability.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier work built manifests, two-path replay, perturbation matrices, cross-owner history, and common-mode budgets. V8 creates an executor-facing blinded commitment and explicit result-return contract while preserving the independent-team gap.

proposals.title: Thermo-psyche promotion-burden state machine
proposals.mission_surface: explicit classification and evidence burdens for thermo/psyche candidates
proposals.hypothesis: A state machine can require class-specific evidence before a statement moves among category barrier, heuristic, normative principle, operational rule, formal invariant, and empirical hypothesis, and can reject notation-only promotion to a fundamental physical or consciousness law.
proposals.null_or_failure: A transition lacks a new evidence obligation, a normative or operational statement becomes a physical law by relabeling, an empirical candidate lacks observation and falsifier requirements, or any consciousness tensor or fundamental thermo/psyche law is declared established.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Enumerate legal and prohibited class transitions, mutate missing observation/falsifier/authority burdens, and require all notation-only, normative-to-physical, and identity-claim promotions to fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the statement to candidate or category-barrier status, retain the failed transition, remove law or consciousness wording, and require the missing domain evidence before reconsideration.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: V6 assigned classes and V7 counterfactually relabeled them. V8 adds explicit promotion and demotion transitions with minimum evidence bundles and prohibited shortcuts.

proposals.title: Stage 20 dependency cut-set and terminal stop-rule audit
proposals.mission_surface: terminal Stage 20 pass/fail/defer board and no-regression decision discipline
proposals.hypothesis: A dependency graph can identify minimal blocking cut-sets for Stage 20 and enforce a stop rule such that any mandatory empirical, independent, legal, cultural, identity, deployment, proof, or security gate that is fail, defer, expired, or retracted forces NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.null_or_failure: A required gate is absent from the graph, a fail or defer is bypassed, a source retraction does not reopen its claim, the stop rule permits readiness with a blocking cut-set, or a prior negative disappears.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Enumerate mandatory gate dependencies, compute minimal blocking sets over fixtures, mutate each decision/expiry/retraction input, preserve all inherited negatives, and require the terminal verdict to remain not ready.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last monotonic board, reinsert omitted negatives and gates, downgrade unsupported passes, and leave Stage 20 closed until every mandatory dependency has exact evidence.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior boards tested evidence decisions, contradictions, lineage monotonicity, claim compression, sunsets, and falsifier-linked expiry. V8 models the gate graph itself and tests minimal blocking cut-sets plus terminal stop-rule completeness.

non_claims: No empirical GMUT confirmation, detected force, unique prediction, real-data likelihood, consciousness tensor, fundamental thermo/psyche law, or Theory of Everything is preregistered.
No blind real-arm THOS superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood result is preregistered.

No production Freed ID, cryptographic assurance, live resolution/status interoperability, deployment, enacted-law status, cultural ratification, Māori authority, exhaustive security, complete accessibility conformance, or independent-team reproduction result is preregistered.
